boundary-analysis.json.scope: Read-only full q8192 MoE gate/up consumer audit. All original selected exact results drive inference and preserve full512 GB10 output/callback boundary. Invariant certificates and range undercoverage are diagnostics. No actual correction is omitted and timing includes audit.

conclusions: Every original gate/up candidate still runs the existing exact K16 replay and writes its original corrected output. The audit observes raw and corrected values plus unchanged norm metadata and the actual CUDA-vLLM SiLU table. Only private1056-byte guarded counters are written by the audit; no candidate is removed and no reference output is a compute input.

For an ordinary finite raw value,the proposed BF16 range contains both original adjacent endpoints and the outward original absolute-error interval. Tiny,nonfinite,overflowing or wider-than-nine-endpoint intervals get no certificate. Gate certification requires every SiLU table entry in the range to match. Up certification requires every rounded product with the already corrected gate to match. SiLU monotonicity is never assumed across its negative minimum.

Each selected actual replay is classified. Invariant consumer outputs are compared directly with the original exact result,while corrected BF16 endpoints outside the proposed range and invalid inputs are counted separately. All40 gate/up pairs complete in the GB10-anchored product run. The coefficient remains empirical; a same-case diagnostic is not a universal interval proof.

Host checks cover all65536 BF16 encodings,four raw mantissa tails and four error scales,1048576 attempted intervals. Outward operations are checked against nextafter and endpoint coverage against independent double intervals. Nonmonotonic synthetic table interiors,signed zero,tiny values,overflow and invalid values are covered. The actual audit owner is tested with every transport failure,guard corruption and a deliberately false invariant certificate. Original threaded MoE scheduling and failure tests still pass.

The unchanged native arithmetic suites emit8 shared and18 routed/shared scaled-fallback reports,with exact raw or BF16 comparisons,norm-bit identity,guards and immutable inputs. Complete local C/Rust/Python checks,clippy and hygiene pass. This diagnostic changes no retained runtime selection or release package.

All512 original GB10 output tokens and actual streaming callbacks,prompt identity and first-logit tolerance0.125 attach to this run. TTFT and TPOT contain audit instrumentation and are not a candidate performance comparison. Any correction-elimination implementation needs complete same-DLL product comparison and the immutable release gates.
